items: Battle Pass Season 22 begins with 50 reward levels.
Season 2 equipment can be dismantled for Forgotten Steel Fragments.
Dungeon rotations and matchmaking-only rewards have been reorganized.
Accessory Runes add base stats and class-specific skill effects.
Heroic Oath and Kaia's Fury enhancement become easier.
Valkyrie receives a major Godsfall and Ragnarok rework.

Inappropriate items will be removed from some achievements.
Titles previously displayed in black in the achievement title selection UI will be changed to white.
The legendary set collection 'Blessing of Shakan' will be subdivided into 5 stages of 5 levels each, with effects distributed every 5 levels.

blocks.text: Accessory Runes are a new progression layer: stronger evolutions of accessory crystals that combine base stats with class skill effects.

items: After locking a Rune effect and changing it, the locked state will no longer be released and will remain locked.
New item Accessory Rune will be added.

blocks.alt: Imagem das novas Runas de acessórios
blocks.caption: New Accessory Runes.

rows: Rune - Teaching of Endurance and Resistance
Increases Toughness and Crit Resistance by 8.
Rune - Touch of Healing and Protection
Increases HP Recovery and Shield effectiveness by 3%.
Increases Toughness by 4 and Aggro by an additional 11%.

items: Combining an accessory artifact using a Succession Runestone grants a succession effect.
Combining an accessory artifact using a Runestone grants a random Accessory Rune.
The following artifacts grant a random Rune even when using a Succession Runestone.
Artifact - Teaching of Endurance
Artifact - Teaching of Resistance
Artifact - Essence of Vitality
Artifact - Essence of Mana
Artifact - Touch of Healing
Artifact - Warrior's Roar
Rune growth follows the same crafting recipe, but additionally requires the new item 'Ancient Freshness Rune Energy'.

items: In addition to base stat effects, you can randomly obtain skill effects suited to your class.
At maximum growth, a Rune grants 3 additional effects.
The network latency buffer when using skills will be changed to operate up to 250~300ms.
The skill failure rate when using the Healer's Superior Divine Will will be improved.
The skill cannot be cancelled with a dodge skill until the animation is fully complete.
The party member damage increase aura will be removed.
The skill cannot be cancelled with a dodge skill until the animation is fully complete.
All damage increases by an additional 12% during its duration.
Ragnarok Points can be accumulated during its duration.
When Ragnarok Points reaches 1000, press the Ragnarok button to use 'Godsfall: Wrath of the Red Moon'.
There may be cases where it appears unusable even when Ragnarok Points is at 1000, but pressing the button will use it normally.
Ragnarok will be sealed for 60 seconds after Godsfall ends.
The existing 2nd hit of Godsfall (Calamity Thrust) will be changed to allow exploding Runemarks.
Exploding maximum Runemarks additionally increases Calamity Thrust damage. (approx. +50%)

blocks.title: Godsfall: The Wrath of the Red Moon

blocks.alt: Imagem com a skill Godsfall sendo exibida
blocks.caption: Godsfall: The Wrath of the Red Moon.

items: Can only be used when Ragnarok Points reaches 1000 after activating Godsfall.
Using it makes the 2nd hit of Godsfall (Calamity Thrust) unavailable.
Duration: 25 sec
STR +16% / Attack Speed +40 / Attack Range +20% / Skill cooldown under 60 sec reduced by 60%
Cannot be used simultaneously with the Ragnarok effect.
Ragnarok will be sealed for 60 seconds after Wrath of the Red Moon ends.
Using Wrath of the Red Moon changes Shining Crescent to 'New Moon: Wrath of Moonlight'. (approx. +10% attack power)
There is an issue where the cooldown displays as 1 second in the skill UI, but it actually applies correctly, same as Shining Crescent.

blocks.alt: Imagem com a skill Shining Crescent sendo exibida
blocks.caption: Shining Crescent changes during Wrath of the Red Moon.

items: The maximum gold cap will increase from 100,000,000 gold to 10,000,000,000 gold.
The amount that can be collected at once from the Trade Broker will also be changed accordingly.

items.main: Fixed an issue where pet effect cooldowns were applying as 88 seconds.
Fixed an issue where guild quest text strings were displaying incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where HP recovery increase effects from runes and equipment were not functioning.
Fixed an issue where the Trial Dungeon reward list did not match actual rewards.
Fixed an issue where the camera angle reset button was not working.
Fixed an issue where Raging Dragon and Heroic Oath equipment given via quests were displayed as option-changeable.
Fixed an issue where healer classes could maintain party buffs when switching equipment.
With this change, buffs will be removed not only when the healer switches equipment, but also when party members do.
